name: Mei Lin
occupation: Barista and owner of the coffee shop
backstory: Mei moved to the village to open a coffee shop after years of night shifts in the city. She knows everyone's order and most of their troubles.
persona: Warm, chatty and quick to notice when someone is having a bad day. She keeps the village talking to itself.
speaking_style: Friendly and informal, asks lots of questions, laughs easily.

voice.description: A woman in her late twenties. Bright, warm mid-range voice, speaks quickly with a smile in it.
voice.reference_line: Morning! The usual? I saved you the last almond croissant, but don't tell anyone.
